title: Mosbius Designs
cn: 第 20 集 · 莫斯比厄斯设计
novel:
Ted [[launched|launch]] his own architecture firm: Mosbius Designs. He was [[ambitious|ambitious]] and [[determined|determined]], but also [[nervous|nervous]]. Going [[independent|independent]] meant no safety net.

He hired an assistant named PJ. But PJ was [[lazy|lazy]] and [[incompetent|incompetent]]. Ted [[struggled|struggle]] to get any work done.

Meanwhile, Barney [[fell|fall]] for a woman named Anita. She was beautiful and charming, but Barney [[suspected|suspect]] she might be a corporate [[spy|spy]] sent to [[steal|steal]] company secrets from GNB.

"She's too perfect," Barney told Ted. "Nobody is that perfect without an [[ulterior|ulterior]] [[motive|motive]]."

Barney tried to [[investigate|investigate]] Anita. He followed her, checked her phone, and even [[hacked|hack]] her email. Every clue [[pointed|point]] to her being [[innocent|innocent]].

"Maybe she just likes you," Robin [[suggested|suggest]].

Barney couldn't accept that. He was so used to [[schemes|scheme]] that he couldn't recognize genuine [[affection|affection]].

Ted's firm struggled at first. No clients came. He sat in his empty office, feeling [[defeated|defeat]]. Then he [[received|receive]] a call. A small project. It was not much, but it was a [[start|start]].

"Mosbius Designs is [[open|open]] for business," Ted [[declared|declare]], smiling for the first time in weeks.

Barney, meanwhile, [[pushed|push]] Anita away with his [[paranoia|paranoia]]. She left, and Barney was left [[wondering|wonder]] if he had made a mistake.

launch.en: to start something new, like a business

ambitious.en: having a strong desire to succeed

incompetent.en: not having the skill to do something

struggle.en: to try hard to do something difficult

suspect.en: to think someone might be guilty

steal.en: to take something that is not yours

investigate.en: to try to find the truth

hack.en: to get into a computer system secretly

affection.en: a feeling of liking or caring

defeat.en: to make someone feel they have lost

receive.en: to get something that is given to you

paranoia.en: an unreasonable fear that people are against you
